name: kind-marks
body: Three kinds, visually distinct. Personas are low-poly humanoid robot meshes. Tools are machined housings with an icon faceplate and a nameplate. Processes are drawn as lines and nodes, not a body. Tool naming is verb then noun: icon is the verb, nameplate is the noun. No fourth kind. Tension with bible 4.3 (round human / square machine) is recorded on the spec; do not amend the bible from this issue.
waitingOn: Owner Check. Picture before a mesh or a housing is drawn.
